verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://docs.omnara.com/openapi.json, and the response contains an "openapi" key, so a machine-readable OpenAPI spec is publicly downloadable. The docs confirm a REST API with bearer-token authentication that the spec would describe. Missing for 10: first-party documentation that points users to the spec download, and evidence that the spec covers the full API surface and is kept versioned and current.
